en: Nitrogen gas makes up exactly 78 percent of the air we breathe, while oxygen makes up 21 percent.
Osmium is the densest naturally occurring element, weighing twice as much as lead for the exact same volume.
One liter of average ocean water contains about 35 grams of dissolved salts, mostly sodium chloride.
When iron rusts, it expands up to six times its original volume, which can crack surrounding concrete.
Water is unique because it expands by about nine percent in volume when it freezes into solid ice.
Tungsten has the highest melting point of all metals, remaining solid until it reaches 3,422 degrees Celsius.
A single drop of whole milk contains roughly three billion tiny fat globules suspended in liquid water.
Diamond is the hardest natural mineral, being roughly 58 times harder than the next hardest mineral, corundum.
Helium gas is lighter than air, allowing one cubic meter to lift roughly one kilogram of weight.
Mixing one gram of baking soda with excess vinegar produces about 260 milliliters of carbon dioxide gas.
Abaca, a plant native to the Philippines, produces the strongest natural fiber in the world, resisting saltwater damage.
Over 99 percent of the visible universe is made of plasma, a superheated, highly charged state of matter.
